title: Tool policy
description: Decides which tool calls of the agent being built are allowed, need a human, or are denied. Most restrictive matching decision wins.

mode.description: attended: a human can answer confirmations. unattended: nobody can answer, so every confirm becomes deny.

default.description: Decision when no rule matches. Never allow: a tool nobody classified must not run unchecked.

sensitiveTools.description: Patterns of tools that read private data or sensitive systems (property B of the Rule of Two).

untrustedSources.description: Patterns of tools whose results contain content the project does not control, such as web pages or inbound email (property A of the Rule of Two).

ruleOfTwo.description: Minimum decision for a call that changes state or reaches outside (property C), once untrusted content is in the run and a sensitive tool is available.

maxToolCalls.description: Maximum tool calls that may run in one run. Enforced by the policy, not by the loop.

perToolMaxCalls.description: Maximum calls per tool name in one run.

confirmTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a human answer. On timeout the call is denied.

limits.description: Overrides for the agent loop limits. An omitted value keeps the loop default.

toolPattern.description: A tool name, or a pattern where * matches any run of characters.

rule.description: Matches a call when every field it has matches. A missing external means any value. A tool with no external field counts as false.
